449:t_1:3.en: ～$$マクロス・クォーター$$　Hangar～

449:t_1:4.en:
$$ラルク$$
「$$ノノ$$...! What do you mean, you're not going!?」

449:t_1:5.en:
$$ノノ$$
「Exactly what I said. $$ノノ$$ will stay behind on the moon.」

449:t_1:6.en:
$$チコ$$
「$$宇宙怪獣$$ are coming, and you call yourself a $$トップレス$$ trainee!? What are you talking about!?」

449:t_1:8.en:
$$ノノ$$
「...Because as things stand, $$ノノ$$ would just hold everyone back...」

449:t_1:9.en:
$$チコ$$
「Well, yeah. You don't even have a $$バスターマシン$$.」

449:t_1:12.en:
$$チコ$$
「You've stuck to rear support so far, but now that the $$宇宙怪獣$$ are attacking in earnest, you'll have to go to the front sometimes.」

449:t_1:15.en:
$$ノノ$$
「So $$ノノ$$ will cheer you all on from the moon.」

449:t_1:20.en:
$$ラルク$$
「Let her go, $$ノリコ$$! If she doesn't want to come, leave her alone!」

449:t_1:22.en:
$$ラルク$$
「...It's better for her that way too... Fighting $$宇宙怪獣$$... isn't easy...」

449:t_1:25.en:
$$ノリコ$$
($$ラルク$$... You're the one I'm worried about...)

449:t_1:32.en:
$$ノノ$$
「Why are you here!? $c is about to leave!」

449:t_1:33.en:
$$シンジ$$
「I... wanted to talk to you, $$ノノ$$...」

449:t_1:34.en:
$$ノノ$$
「Are you about to confess your love!?」

449:t_1:35.en:
$$ノノ$$
「But you can't! Doing that right before a sortie is what they call a death flag!」

449:t_1:36.en:
$$ノノ$$
「Besides, $$ノノ$$ has Big Sis, and you have $$レイ#pt394$$, $$アスカ$$, $$マリ$$, and even $$カヲル$$...」

449:t_1:38.en:
$$ノノ$$
「...I'm sorry. $$ノノ$$... got a little carried away.」

449:t_1:39.en:
$$シンジ$$
「Did you leave the ship because you don't have a $$バスターマシン$$?」

449:t_1:40.en:
$$ノノ$$
「Exactly! $$ノノ$$ needs a $$バスターマシン$$! Because...!」

449:t_1:41.en:
$$シンジ$$
「Can't you fight without a machine?」

449:t_1:44.en:
$$ノノ$$
「...Big Sis... feels so far away to $$ノノ$$ right now. So to get closer to her, $$ノノ$$...」

449:t_1:45.en:
$$シンジ$$
「I'll ask again. Can't you fight without a $$バスターマシン$$?」

449:t_1:46.en:
$$ノノ$$
「$$ノノ$$ needs a $$バスターマシン$$! I want Big Sis to acknowledge me...! Otherwise, $$ノノ$$...!」

449:t_1:47.en:
$$ノノ$$
「You have an EVA, $$シンジ$$. You could never understand how $$ノノ$$ feels.」

449:t_1:50.en:
$$シンジ$$
「I've always been forced to pilot the EVA. Nobody cared what I wanted...」

449:t_1:51.en:
$$シンジ$$
「But I... piloted the EVA because I wanted Father to praise me.」

449:t_1:52.en:
$$シンジ$$
「Just like you want a $$バスターマシン$$ so $$ラルク$$ will acknowledge you.」

449:t_1:54.en:
$$シンジ$$
「But I think there's something wrong with that.」

449:t_1:55.en:
$$シンジ$$
「I can't explain it well, but a real parent and child are still parent and child without having to do that...」

449:t_1:56.en:
$$ノノ$$
「Your father isn't in this world... Will you still pilot the EVA?」

449:t_1:57.en:
$$シンジ$$
「I... don't really know what I want either... Right now... the EVA is all I have...」

449:t_1:58.en:
$$シンジ$$
「But before, I did want to fight. Even without an EVA, I wanted to fight alongside everyone as part of $c.」

449:t_1:59.en:
$$シンジ$$
「Don't you feel that way, $$ノノ$$? Can't you fight without a machine?」

449:t_1:60.en:
$$ノノ$$
「...$$シンジ$$... It's almost time. You have to go.」

449:t_1:62.en:
$$ノノ$$
「Thank you for coming. Your words... made me happy.」

449:t_1:63.en:
$$シンジ$$
「So you're not changing your mind?」

449:t_1:65.en:
$$ノノ$$
「But $$ノノ$$ will... return to everyone and Big Sis, no matter what.」

449:t_1:68.en:
$$ノノ$$
「Please tell me one last thing. Why did you come to see $$ノノ$$, $$シンジ$$?」

449:t_1:69.en:
$$シンジ$$
「...There's something... I can't stop thinking about...」

449:t_1:71.en:
$$シンジ$$
「Those words you always say... Hard work and guts...」

449:t_1:72.en:
$$シンジ$$
「I know they don't really suit me, but when I hear them, I feel like I could accomplish something if I tried...」

449:t_1:73.en:
$$ノノ$$
「I'm happy to hear you say that. Though $$ノノ$$ didn't come up with those words...」

449:t_1:75.en:
$$ノノ$$
「Those are $$ノノリリ$$'s words. The legendary space pilot who saved Earth...」

449:t_1:76.en:
$$ノノ$$
「$$ノノ$$ feels the same as you. Those words help me keep trying, no matter how hard things get.」

449:t_1:77.en:
$$シンジ$$
「You're trying hard right now too, aren't you?」

449:t_1:79.en:
$$ノノ$$
「Now, hurry along... $$アスカ$$'s over there glaring at us with a really scary look on her face.」

449:t_1:80.en:
$$シンジ$$
「Then I'll be going. Let's make sure we meet again, $$ノノ$$.」

449:t_1:81.en:
$$ノノ$$
「...Thank you. You've given me courage, $$シンジ$$.」

449:t_1:82.en:
$$カシオ$$
「He's a strange boy. Just when I think he's terribly timid, he does something I could never have imagined...」

449:t_1:83.en:
$$カシオ$$
「I suppose that's what a true boy is like...」

449:t_1:85.en:
$$カシオ$$
「That helps. On my own, I wouldn't have a way to get there, and we might have to do some excavating too.」
